details: For every finite binary class, the minimum star number is at least VC dimension.
proof: If a set of size d is shattered, then for any centre labeling g its restriction to that set is realized by one hypothesis, and each one-coordinate flip is realized by another. Thus this set is a g-centred star of size d; minimize over g.
witness_verification: For the universal class with $n$ concepts, the recorded lower bound on minimum star number is $n/2-1$, while VC dimension is $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$.
name: Minimum Star Number / VC Dimension
